'''''What We Do''''' is a studio album by [[jazz]] guitarist John Scofield, the second to be released as the [[Meant to Be (John Scofield album)|John Scofield Quartet]]. It was recorded in May 1992 and released the following year on [[Blue Note Records|Blue Note]]. The quartet features saxophonist [[Joe Lovano]], bassist [[Dennis Irwin]] (replacing [[Marc Johnson (musician)|Marc Johnson]]) and drummer [[Bill Stewart (musician)|Bill Stewart]]. Irwin had previously recorded with Scofield on the [[Bennie Wallace]] album ''Sweeping Through the City'', and went on to play on two additional Scofield albums: ''[[Hand Jive (album)|Hand Jive]]'' (1994) and ''[[Groove Elation]]'' (1995).
